sections.label: Infrastructure & Utilities
sections.summary: Comprehensive utilities coordination documentation is required for overhead and underground electrical facilities, including conductor elevations and clearances, transformer equipment specifications and easements, facility classification, and structural interface verification.

sections.label: Street Trees & Landscaping
sections.summary: Tree species selection must comply with clearance requirements from overhead and underground electrical facilities; Austin Energy written approval is required for all utility-adjacent plantings.

sections.label: Fire Access & Life Safety
sections.summary: Fire safety clearances around transformer equipment and utilities must be documented and verified in accordance with code requirements.

sections.label: Plan Documentation & Administrative
sections.summary: Construction phase safety requirements and equipment clearance specifications must be explicitly documented in the construction and operations plans.
